en: Colorized vintage view over a river valley with hills in the background. A long arched stone bridge carries a railway line with a train in the foreground. On a hill to the right stands a large rectangular castle-like building with a tall church tower and red roof, overlooking the river and town. Small houses with red roofs line the opposite bank. Printed red text at the top names the place and identifies the castle.
